rootCauses.A_B: Frontend draft helper signature changed and encoded a composite route as one ID. Existing callers/controller contract stayed unchanged; GET context became a 404 and POST/PUT arguments shifted.
rootCauses.A_public: Creation failed so postingId stayed undefined; independently Sprint4 detail renderer lacked shared data-public-job article.
rootCauses.C: Minimal DOM does not implement lastElementChild. Real-browser application regression is replacement of shared preview/public renderer with a separate detail template. Restore existing shared renderer and retain application controls outside its article.
rootCauses.domClear: Use textContent to clear stale nodes consistently in native and test DOM; no mock weakening.
